podcast_page.intro: In October 2016, I launched the Social Media and Politics Podcast, an interview-driven podcast that explores politically relevant topics in the social media space.
body_paragraphs: Episodes are released bi-monthly and communicate expert insights from top-tier researchers, digital campaigners, and social media strategists.
Podcasting has quickly become one of my greatest passions, and it's all thanks to the listeners and guests who contribute their time to support the show.
So far, the series has garnered over 175,000 downloads from 150+ countries. Even if you're not a podcast listener, I'd encourage you to try it out!
You can find the Social Media and Politics Podcast on any podcast app.
